4934.title: Native image result retains file-read classification
4934.rootCauseOneLine: Native Read completion retains its initial fileRead shape and presentation despite successful image content.
4934.proposedFix: Validate native image blocks and promote only successful reads with known paths at completion, preserving identity and negative controls.
4934.caveats: Two clean translator reproductions; no live model, host-file load, or browser rendering. Local candidate passes 16 regressions and static checks, but five baseline bridge-test failures block a PR.
